::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 23d 1889  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 13
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

Many thanks for the account and the [cheques](organizations/other_160.qmd) for which I enclose receipts.

I will keep [the Molyneuxes](other_books/otherbook_1087.qmd) till you return, as they give much pleasure here.[^1] I think it should be observed to the author that there is an inconsistency in making the estate come through the mother and then placing a Molyneux ancestry there.

Also I think the Baptism of Eggs is an expression not desirable in a child’s book.

When you return there will be plenty of time to see about the Advertisements for next year

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This, *Shreds and Patches*, was a story by [Ella Napier Lefroy](people/person_863.qmd), one of Innes's authors, which CMY had considered for [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd) but did not in fact appear there.
